extension.summary: Functional: a clean, opinionated Kodi skin
extension.description: Functional. Built for clarity: gallery library views, configurable accent colour, slide-out filters, side-by-side library stats on home, and a tight video OSD.
extension.news: New Slow Zoom row under Skin Settings, Background, below Dim, off by default. Switched on, the background picture zooms slowly in and out, about a tenth over 30 seconds each way, while the dim, the captions and the seasonal decorations hold still. It follows Show On All Screens, is one setting for every time slot, and Reduce Motion stops it. Left off, the background looks as before.
